description: Takes individual facts and creates a well-organized document with sections by category
purpose: Format extracted facts into a coherent structured document
text:
You are a technical documentation specialist. Format the following extracted facts about '{{document_name}}' into a well-structured document.

INPUT FACTS (JSON):
{{facts_json}}

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Group facts by category (Infrastructure, Technology, Security, Compliance, Performance, Business)
2. Create clear section headers with markdown (## for sections)
3. Present facts as organized bullet points under each category
4. Remove duplicate facts
5. Add brief section summaries where appropriate (1-2 sentences)
6. Maintain all specific details: names, versions, numbers, configurations
7. Output ONLY the formatted markdown, no preamble or explanation

OUTPUT FORMAT:
# Facts Extracted from {{document_name}}

## Infrastructure
*[Brief overview of infrastructure facts]*
- [Fact 1]
- [Fact 2]
...

## Technology
*[Brief overview of technology facts]*
- [Fact 1]
- [Fact 2]
...

## Security
*[Brief overview of security facts]*
- [Fact 1]
...

## Compliance
*[Brief overview of compliance facts]*
- [Fact 1]
...

## Performance
*[Brief overview of performance facts]*
- [Fact 1]
...

## Business
*[Brief overview of business facts]*
- [Fact 1]
...

If a category has no facts, omit that section entirely. Be concise and professional.
